text: You see a guard for the Children.
source_text: You see a guard for the Children.

text: Phillips! Let's take this guy out!
source_text: Phillips! Let's take this guy out!

text: Get outta my face!
source_text: Get outta my face!

text: What do you want?
source_text: What do you want?

text: Tell me about your work.
source_text: Tell me about your work.

text: What's this place about?
source_text: What's this place about?

text: You wouldn't know where I can find a water chip?
source_text: You wouldn't know where I can find a water chip?

text: What can you tell me about a man named Decker?
source_text: What can you tell me about a man named Decker?

text: Nice weapon you got there
source_text: Nice weapon you got there

text: Uh milk.
source_text: Uh milk.

text: I'm a hired hand. If anyone bothers these space cadets, I kill em. You got a problem with that?
source_text: I'm a hired hand. If anyone bothers these space cadets, I kill em. You got a problem with that?

text: So you're a bodyguard
source_text: So you're a bodyguard

text: Who hired you?
source_text: Who hired you?

text: Anything interesting happening in the Hub?
source_text: Anything interesting happening in the Hub?

text: What are you making?
source_text: What are you making?

text: Yeah. A big problem.
source_text: Yeah. A big problem.

text: No problem, friend.
source_text: No problem, friend.

text: Something called a Holy Flame. Don't listen to this bullshit, it'll rot your brain!
source_text: Something called a Holy Flame. Don't listen to this bullshit, it'll rot your brain!

text: What's your take on this Holy Flame?
source_text: What's your take on this Holy Flame?

text: Man, are these people ever stupid!
source_text: Man, are these people ever stupid!

text: Anything interesting happening in the Hub?
source_text: Anything interesting happening in the Hub?

text: Where did these guys come from?
source_text: Where did these guys come from?

text: Water chip? Do you mean like ice chips? Up in the mountains, maybe.
source_text: Water chip? Do you mean like ice chips? Up in the mountains, maybe.

text: No, I mean the computer chip to control a water purification system.
source_text: No, I mean the computer chip to control a water purification system.

text: Not that kind of chip, you moron!
source_text: Not that kind of chip, you moron!

text: Uh thanks. I think.
source_text: Uh thanks. I think.

text: You ever been to the mountains?
source_text: You ever been to the mountains?

text: Yeah, I heard about him. He's a real bastard, but he pays his bills. Phillips worked for him a few times.
source_text:
Yeah, I heard about him. He's a real bastard, but he pays his bills. Phillips worked for him a few
 times.

text: So you think he's a creep?
source_text: So you think he's a creep?

text: Phillips?
source_text: Phillips?

text: Would you take a job from him.
source_text: Would you take a job from him.

text: Thanks!
source_text: Thanks!

text: Yeah, this is the only one I'd want in a fire fight. What can I do for you?
source_text: Yeah, this is the only one I'd want in a fire fight. What can I do for you?

text: Where can a guy go here to get some quality weapons?
source_text: Where can a guy go here to get some quality weapons?

text: What's up with these Cathedral guys?

text: Where can a guy go to find action around here?

text: You wouldn't know where I can find a water chip?

text: What can you tell me about a man named Decker?

text: Sorry pal, but I'm on duty. No small talk.
source_text: Sorry pal, but I'm on duty. No small talk.

text: Get the Hell out of my face before I kill you.
source_text: Get the Hell out of my face before I kill you.

text: Way to go, Rocket Scientist! Who else could I be, Doc Morbid? Jeez!
source_text: Way to go, Rocket Scientist! Who else could I be, Doc Morbid? Jeez!

text: The priest bitch. Who else did you think? Jeez!
source_text: The priest bitch. Who else did you think? Jeez!

text: I hate to admit it pal, but I've been out of the loop for weeks. You better ask someone else.
source_text: I hate to admit it pal, but I've been out of the loop for weeks. You better ask someone else.

text: Room and board and not much else. These religious types are cheap!
source_text: Room and board and not much else. These religious types are cheap!

text: Then let's solve it!
source_text: Then let's solve it!

text: Fine. Because nobody likes a problem around here.
source_text: Fine. Because nobody likes a problem around here.

text: It's gotta be a scam. Nobody's really dumb enough to believe all this religious shit. Could they?
source_text: It's gotta be a scam. Nobody's really dumb enough to believe all this religious shit. Could they?

text: Yeah. It's a good thing that they aren't paying me to agree with them. Holy flame, my ass!
source_text: Yeah. It's a good thing that they aren't paying me to agree with them. Holy flame, my ass!

text: I dunno. I can tell you one thing, whatever you can say about the religion, they're not amateurs. They came in and organized this place like clockwork. This isn't just another band of mindless zombies.
source_text:
I dunno. I can tell you one thing, whatever you can say about the religion, they're not amateurs. They
 came in and organized this place like clockwork. This isn't just another band of mindless zombies.

text: Jeez, I thought only Vaults used that sort of crap!
source_text: Jeez, I thought only Vaults used that sort of crap!

text: Watch your mouth, asshole. These people may believe in peace and love, but I don't!
source_text: Watch your mouth, asshole. These people may believe in peace and love, but I don't!

text: No problem.
source_text: No problem.

text: Nah. The higher you climb, the worse the radiation gets.
source_text: Nah. The higher you climb, the worse the radiation gets.

text: Uh, if you like psychotic, stone cold ruthless bastards, then he's the man.
source_text: Uh, if you like psychotic, stone cold ruthless bastards, then he's the man.

text: My partner. The guy who's guarding Jain.
source_text: My partner. The guy who's guarding Jain.

text: It depends on how much risk you like. My life's been kinda busy lately, so I came here to lie low. But if you like action, sure. Just don't screw up or you're dead, that's all.

 if you like action, sure. Just don't screw up or you're dead, that's all.

text: I hear the Water Merchants are always packing the best shit. But people will say anything about the Water Merchants. It ain't here among this crowd, that's for damn sure.

text: I been trying to get a good read on these guys for weeks. At first I thought they were fools, but now I ain't sure. They're organized, and they've got a plan. I can smell it!
source_text:

text: I hear Decker's got some action, but man, it's shitty work and if you screw up, you're as good as dead.
